verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 ships a few fixed, user-configurable automatic behaviors: soft and hard TTLs that auto-pause or auto-delete on expiry, auto_resume that wakes a paused sandbox on inbound access, and online RootFS growth. Its webhooks also emit process, lifecycle and file-modification events, but the user must build the reacting action outside the product. There is no general rules engine for defining custom event-to-action triggers. Missing for 10: a user-defined rule/trigger engine with arbitrary conditions and actions, built-in actions triggered by webhook events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
